name: Ahmed ElSamman
tagline: I turn complex products into clear, thoughtful interfaces.
shortBio: I'm Ahmed, a frontend engineer in Cairo. I build Angular and React applications for learning platforms, industrial dashboards, and everyday tools, with a focus on clear interactions, reusable components, and Arabic / English experiences.

identityNarrative.heading: Real products, real workflows
identityNarrative.body: My work started with business systems in Odoo. Today I build frontend applications for learning platforms and factories, turning detailed requirements into interfaces people can work with every day.

identityNarrative.heading: Built for both directions
identityNarrative.body: Arabic and English interfaces are part of my day-to-day work. I pay attention to layout direction, responsive behavior, and reusable components so the experience stays consistent across screens.

identityNarrative.heading: Better work through collaboration
identityNarrative.body: I work closely with backend and UX teams, and I have taught Angular, React, and TypeScript at ITI. Reviewing code and helping trainees through their projects made explaining technical decisions a regular part of my work.

achievements: Built multi-tenant learning interfaces with Angular and Nx.
Developed industrial dashboards for machines and production lines.
Taught frontend development and mentored MEARN Stack trainees at ITI.
